title: Venture Dollars For Black Startup Founders Stay Scarce Despite AI Funding Boom (Crunchbase News)
notes: Crunchbase News (Mary Ann Azevedo), 2026-05-28. 2025: $942M (0.32%) to Black-founder startups. 2026 YTD (to May 20): $643M, mostly Q1 (best quarter since Q2 2022). Driven by SambaNova Feb $350M Series E; 'co-founded in 2017 by chief technologist Kunle Olukotun... raised a total of $1.5 billion in known funding'; Cambium + Vista co-led. Standouts: SambaNova, Novig ($75M B, Pantera, $500M), Harper ($47M A, Emergence, YC), Posh ($37M B, FirstMark), GovDash ($30M B, BCI+Mucker).
